notes: וַיְהִי־לוֹ is read exactly as rule 43 directs: the existential verb takes the recast had, the possessive לְ is unrepresented under rule 40, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun he.

The one multi-token source unit is הַחוּצָה's noun with its directive he rendered by the single word abroad, fused under rules 30 and 32 and headed on the lexeme-bearing noun; the article beside it takes no written the and is unrepresented (rule 29). The later bare חוּץ takes its own abroad with its article unrepresented.

The in of he brought in is retained with בּוֹא hiphil, whose lexeme is causing to enter; rule 44's surplus-particle ruling reaches a back that adds a direction the Hebrew does not write, which this is not.
